name: Restate
summary: Restate is a durable execution runtime that journals each step of a handler so code resumes from the last completed step after a crash, restart or deploy. Beyond workflows it offers keyed state (Virtual Objects), durable RPC, timers and queues. It ships as a single Rust binary with no external database or broker, and is also offered as a managed cloud.
facts: TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, Ruby
Self-hosted binary, Restate Cloud, or BYOC (AWS, GCP)
goodFor: Durable agent loops and tool calls
watchOut: Server is source-available (BSL), not OSI open source
